title: Optimizing Antibiotic Use in Long Term Care
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to determine if a multi-faceted intervention to implement diagnostic and therapeutic algorithms for management of suspected urinary infection in nursing home residents could reduce antibiotic prescribing for urinary indications in this population.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Individuals- all residents eligible
2. Nursing homes

   * Free standing long term care facilities with \>100 beds
   * No stated policy for diagnosis or treatment of urinary tract infections
   * The facility agrees to refrain from introducing new strategies for antibiotic utilization or clinical pathways during study

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
